title: Halidzor Fortress

terrainReference.basis: Near the centre of the mapped interior building way 541598186.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap fortress identity, nearby buildings, two standing walls and access controls (ODbL 1.0)
mapIdentity.scope: Two native wall centerlines and three building polygons fix the irregular mapped fort and historic church precinct. The Armenian survey gives masonry and surviving tower dimensions. The named fortress node anchors this site at Kapan.

note: Source relief follows the 256 m Terrarium field. The architecture survey describes one-metre curtains, distinct exterior and interior east wall heights, a five-metre tower, and the broad vaulted church with 1.6 m walls and a two-metre bell opening.
